boundaries.name: Atlas Admin Boundaries
boundaries.description: Admin boundaries for the Atlas based on GAUL 2024. This includes admin 0, 1, and 2 levels.

raster_boundaries.name: Rasterized Atlas Admin Boundaries
raster_boundaries.description: Admin boundaries for the Atlas based on GAUL 2024. This includes admin 0, 1, and 2 levels. These have been rasterized to meet the resolution requirements of the Adaptation Atlas (0.05 degrees) and are useful for zonal extractions.
raster_boundaries.methods: Rasterized the raw GAUL 2024 boundaries. This includes all conflicted boundaries, but waterbodies have been removed.

hazard_change.name: Hazard Change & Frequency (by admin)
hazard_change.description: Admin-summarised climate-hazard change products derived from the NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 hazard timeseries: PTOT (precipitation total) percent-of-area change and absolute change vs the 1995-2014 historic baseline, THI (livestock heat) and NTx35/NTx40 (crop heat) percent-of-area exceeding severe/extreme thresholds, and NDWS/NDWL0 drought/wet-spell frequency. Each product ships a per-GCM `by_model` table and a cross-model `ensemble` table (mean/min/max/sd). All tables are iso3-first sorted with non-null iso3 row-group statistics for per-country pruning.
hazard_change.methods: Generated by R/2.2_haz_change.R. Hazard rasters are masked/classified, areas summed (or frequencies meaned) by admin unit via admin_extract(boundaries_zonal, boundaries_index), expressed as percent of admin area (or scaled to a count of years for frequency_n), then summarised across the 18 GCMs. PTOT relative change (100 x (future - historic)/historic) is masked to NULL where the 20-year historic baseline PTOT < 100 mm/yr: below this hyper-arid threshold the denominator approaches zero so within-noise differences yield spurious large percentages, and 100 mm/yr is the conventional desert isohyet below which rainfed agriculture is absent (cf. UNEP/UNESCO aridity index; Copernicus C3S ~0.3 mm/day mask). In those cells the absolute change ptot_diff (Δmm, computed from the unmasked baseline) is reported instead, so ptot_diff retains full coverage. Remaining non-finite values in zero-coverage admin units (no grid cells) are also set to NULL. See ISSUE_cr093_nan_zeroprecip.md.
hazard_change.notes: Validated by R/validate_cr093_real.R (iso3 present, 0% NA, prunable row-group stats, ensembles carry mean/min/max/sd). by_model variables: ptot_change_by_model, ptot_diff_by_model, thi_perc_area_by_model, ntx_perc_area_by_model, haz_freq. ensemble variables: same stems with _ensemble (haz_freq_ensemble). haz_freq / haz_freq_ensemble live locally under hazard_timeseries_risk/{timeframe}/stats/, the rest under hazard_timeseries_mean/{timeframe}/{ptot_perc,thi_perc,ntx_perc}/.
